entities.summary: William Jamahl Harris is an American professional football safety for the Washington Commanders of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Boston College Eagles and was selected by the Detroit Lions in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft. Harris has also played for the New Orleans Saints.
